Demolition of existing vacant two storey warehouse building. Redevelopment of site to provide 156 residential units, through erection of a four storey linear building (with five storey element to west end) adjacent to railway line; erection of five detached blocks (one x six-storey, three x five-storey and one x four-storey buildings) and other non housing development.
